title: So Cute!
text: So Cute!. These rainbow gnomes are so cute! I have decided to decorate my tiered tray for Pride month in June and these guys will look great on it! The rainbow and one of the balloons on the lady gnome were both loose when it arrived. I'll have to glue it back on. But other than that, they're just fine!

product_metadata.title: CRCZK Birthday Gnomes Plush, Farmhouse Happy Birthday Gnome Gifts Handmade Scandinavian Nisse Home Party Elf Dwarf Collections Kitchen Tiered Tray Happy Birthday Decorations
features: [Birthday Party Decor ] --- Happy Birthday Gnomes is perfect decorations for your Birthday Party, can be put on Tiered Tray, Shelf, Table or a special place in your Party.
[ Ideal Birthday Gift] --- The adorable tomte gnome is perfect gift for Gnome Collection Lovers. If She/He loves Gnomes, cannot find better birthday gift than this gnome couple.

[ Premium Material & Handmade ] --- Birthday gnomes are made of Soft Fur and Plush, one with colorful balloon in her hand, and the other helds the 'Happy Birthday ' Signs. Both have colorful hats, bright color for parties.
[ Weighted Base ] --- Each Birthday gnome plush has a built-in soft iron wire in the top hat. Poseable and Bendable. There is sand at the bottom to make the gnomes sit stably.
[Good Fortuen ] --- Gnome, also known as a Tomte or Nisse.In folklore, Gnome guards home and protect people from misfortune. The elf birthday gnome will bring good luck,happiness, warmth.
